title: Canonical compact-support projection comparison square
statement: For any finite commutative ring B and chosen compactification c=(i,g) of a scheme morphism f, let EX,EY be derived comparison inverse images, FE,FP the two compact-support functors, PE,PP the derived pullbacks, beta the canonical compact-support comparison, tX,tY the canonical tensor comparisons, pb the canonical pullback comparison, and pfE,pfP the named projection maps [def-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transport-data]. Let q=tX followed by id⊗pb. For every unbounded M,K, EY(pfE_M,K)≫beta_(M⊗PEK)≫FP(q_M,K)=tY_(FEM),K≫(beta_M⊗id)≫pfP_EXM,EYK. No projection invertibility is asserted or assumed.

source.place: Proof (3), finite-ring tensor formula; explicit site transport steps of lem-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transpose

proof.text: For the proper factor transpose the projection square under derived pullback/direct image. Normalize the direct-image comparison by its counit-mate equation. The projection-map definition and tensor/pullback comparison reduce both adjuncts to the same counit tensored with identity.

For the open factor restrict the adjuncts to the open, where both send a pure tensor to itself. Use exact extension by zero and K-flat representatives to descend this degreewise equality. Paste the open and proper squares and use naturality. The outside beta is the proper comparison followed by direct image of the open comparison, exactly the named canonical beta.
